name: Parrot Tool Hardening
intent: Turn a copied local_null_ai tool into a stronger local agent-usable tool while preserving the original site/tool folder.
scope: Work only inside the selected local_null_ai_* tool folder.
Do not modify original non-prefixed folders.
Do not reinstall dependencies unless explicitly requested.
Document runtime, inputs, outputs, and safety boundaries.

steps.title: Inventory the tool
steps.prompt: Inspect package files, Python entrypoints, README files, scripts, and existing runtime assumptions. Summarize what the tool does and what an agent could safely automate.

steps.title: Create an agent contract
steps.prompt: Add or update a concise AGENTS.md or TOOL.md explaining commands, inputs, outputs, logs, safe operating scope, and validation.

steps.title: Expose a local runner
steps.prompt: Add a minimal CLI or script wrapper if the tool lacks a predictable local entrypoint. Prefer dependency-free wrappers where possible.

steps.title: Validate without pretending
steps.prompt: Run the smallest available validation. If dependencies are missing, state the exact command that could not run and why.
